exclusions.reason: User excludes advanced-only configuration. Visit entry/back boundary only; provider internals, full bundle/module authoring, ready-conversation retention and terminal automation are not executed unless a standard alternate route below exposes them.

Only advanced chat entry exposes worktree handoff, cross-host portability, saved-task/goal controls and schedules. No copied schedules or worker replay are enabled. Workspace work review/assignment controls have a separate standard path and are included.
Direct raw session tool invocation, module mutation, capability grants and artifact runtime controls are advanced-only. Ordinary composer bundle/model/effort and Settings Smart Tools remain included.

entryPath: Memory & past work / Files this chat can edit / Project file access
exclusions.reason: Advanced-only per-chat recall and write overrides excluded. Standard Privacy file access and Chat info context/usage remain included.
Arbitrary CSS/code/plugin authoring is outside standard detail. Saved appearance gallery, layout/detail preferences and ordinary interactive rendered components remain included.
Destructive global reset/repair not part of standard smoke; Privacy→Backups & recovery entry and safe backup are included. Do not operate on private replica.

entryPath: Advanced source/import expectations or Advanced collection inputs
exclusions.reason: Manual repository/dependency JSON and result override declarations are explicitly advanced. Standard source inspection and safe local validation remain included.

Live OAuth/accounts, paid provider calls, OS permissions, external publication, email/notification delivery and production update are not silently marked passed. UI uses controlled synthetic services; actual external acceptance is blocked with an explicit reason.

openInventoryQuestions.detail: Runtime-generated provider models, tool schemas, A2UI/MCP controls, shell extension slots, options and per-resource actions need a rendered enumeration in supported synthetic states. They cannot be counted from JSX tags.
ComputationPanel and OperationsPanel have native controls but no static import from bundled entry. Verify registration/actual route before excluding.

Native control crosswalk maps candidate workflows by source owner, not individual assertion. Reviewer must confirm condition/label/option instance and record excluded reasons before final pass accounting.
Physical voice/screen permissions, real remote providers/auth and external publishing remain explicitly unqualified by synthetic UI tests.
